module: "First Drive" tutorial telemetry tracker: the session (activity "firstDriveActive"), its lessons (started, stopped, completed, with duration) and the vehicle recoveries made during the session. Outside a session, only a "firstDriveProgress" snapshot (completed lessons, read from settings/firstDriveLearning.json) is sent, at most once per survey interval or when the progress changes.
notes: Vehicle changes (vehicleUsed) and resets (vehicleReset) come from the vehicle tracker and are not repeated here; a recovery also triggers trackVehReset so it also appears as a vehicleReset.
Session end reasons (onFirstDriveEnded): completed, skipToFreeroam, mainMenu, startFailed, clientEndMission; internally also restarted (restart from the pause menu) and trackerUnloaded.
Lesson stop reasons: pauseMenu when the player stops it, otherwise leftArea, leftStartArea, sessionEnded, completionFailed or a reason specific to the lesson (e.g. vehicleChanged).
Default survey interval: 7 days (24*7 h) via telemetry_configManager.getSurveyIntervalHours; the last survey sent is stored in surveys/firstDriveSurvey.json of the telemetry data folder.
Extension in manual unload: the core unloads the trackers before their onExit, so the session end is done in onExtensionUnloaded.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called on load: manual unload, then possible send of the progress snapshot.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook called on unload (game close, Lua reload or tracker disabled): ends the session with the reason trackerUnloaded.

onFirstDriveStarted.desc: Hook called when First Drive starts (also on a restart from the pause menu, which closes the previous session): starts the firstDriveActive activity with completed lessons.

startAtLookout.desc: true if the start is at the viewpoint.

onFirstDriveEnded.desc: Hook called when First Drive ends: ends the activity; if reason is completed, also emits firstDriveCompleted with the duration.

reason.desc: completed, skipToFreeroam, mainMenu, startFailed or clientEndMission.

onFirstDriveLessonStarted.desc: Hook called at the start of a lesson: emits firstDriveLessonStarted (ignored outside a session).

onFirstDriveLessonStopped.desc: Hook called when a lesson is interrupted: emits firstDriveLessonStopped with reason and duration.

onFirstDriveLessonCompleted.desc: Hook called when a lesson is passed: emits firstDriveLessonCompleted with duration.

onStopRecovering.desc: Hook called when vehicle recovery stops: emits firstDriveVehicleRecovered with the hold duration, the phase and the lesson (ignored during the recovery preview).
